description: Static installed option inventory, not a live game registry dump. Each authored option has exact mapping, stat and collectible provenance; cosmetic attribute families are separately recorded.

method.sources: Enabled evpack.json Mods; base game 1.22.7 JSON expanded through worldproperty variant groups; active compatibility subtree only; matching is exact Code.Path, as Toolsmith registers it.
method.variantPatch: Wool fabricstrips variant appended by Toolsmith cloth patch when Wool is installed; both active patches have the same idempotent union effect.
method.scope: Authored mapping inventory, not arbitrary tools, workaround attributed handles, or every Cartesian product. No target DLL is executed. Inactive meteoricsteel/uraniumexpanded mappings and all unresolved candidates are retained as excluded evidence.
method.species: Wood texture choices do not select a different handle stat tag. Crude handles have no wood attribute dimension; do not invent per-species crude handles.
method.grouping: Only colour/pattern/wood/orientation/stone variants of the same material/product with equal runtime stats and recipe properties share a row. Distinct materials and acquisition routes remain separate rows even if numbers coincide.

handles.label: Stick
handles.note: Immediate first handle; no carving needed.

handles.label: Bone
handles.note: A small HP and binding-support improvement over a stick.

handles.label: Crude handle
handles.note: Carve firewood with a knife; a starter without a saw.

handles.label: Carved handle
handles.note: Carve a support beam with a knife; the first speed improvement.

handles.label: Carpented handle
handles.note: Knife, support beam and one sandpaper in the grid; more HP, binding support and speed.

grips.label: Wool twine
grips.note: All installed colours, including mordant and dark shades.

grips.label: Linen sheets
grips.note: Diamond, normal, offset and square patterns; all are down-facing blocks.

grips.label: Linen cloth
grips.note: Plain, mordant and all installed vanilla colours.

grips.label: Tailor's Delight dark cloth
grips.note: Dark blue, dark brown, dark green and dark red.

grips.label: Wool cloth
grips.note: All installed colours, including mordant and dark shades.

grips.label: Wool
grips.note: All installed colours, including four dark shades.

grips.label: Normal leather
grips.note: Plain and all ten dyed colours; no speed or wear differences.

bindings.label: Tailor's Delight twine
bindings.note: All installed dyed, mordant and dark colours.

bindings.label: Wool twine
bindings.note: All installed colours, including mordant and dark shades.

bindings.label: Metal parts
bindings.note: Uses the cupronickel stat set, not the steel stat set.

maintenance.label: Whetstones
maintenance.note: Five stones: chert, granite, andesite, basalt and peridotite. All have 300 durability and the same sharpening routine.

maintenance.label: Grindstones
maintenance.note: Four stones: granite, sandstone, shale and andesite; four placement orientations each. Same sharpening routine.

maintenance.label: Workbench
maintenance.note: Same bench for assembly and component replacement; rotate to face any of four directions.

maintenance.label: Sandpaper
maintenance.note: Native maintenance-tagged consumable for carpented-handle crafting; not a sharpener or HP repair.

nativeFamilyEvidence.notes: Wood and leather are attribute-based families, not hypothetical collectible suffix variants. The existing converter constructs their native stacks and uses GuiHandbookItemStackPage.PageCodeForStack.
